name: The Business Platinum Card from American Express

annual_fee.note: Major refresh on 2025-09-18; the increased fee applied to existing-account renewals from 2025-12-02. New applicants from the 2025-09-18 refresh; existing accounts at renewals from 2025-12-02. The earlier fee is not in the catalog.

benefits.name: Lodging credit
benefits.enrollment_how: No separate enrollment; link an Airbnb account for Airbnb bookings.
benefits.qualifying: Prepaid Fine Hotels + Resorts, The Hotel Collection and Airbnb Luxe bookings made through Amex Travel; The Hotel Collection and Luxe need 2 nights.
benefits.note: Processed by period end (11:59 p.m. Central). Amex terms effective 2026-10-22 broadened the older $600 Hotel Credit to include Airbnb Luxe; the product page still uses the old name in places. One-night Fine Hotels + Resorts stays stay eligible until the two-night minimum starts 2027-01-01.

benefits.name: Airbnb Experiences credit
benefits.enrollment_how: Unlock each year with a confirmed qualifying prepaid Airbnb Luxe booking.
benefits.qualifying: Experiences sold directly by Airbnb once unlocked; purchases redirected to third parties are excluded.
benefits.note: Cancelling all qualifying Luxe bookings can reverse the credits.

requires.note: unlocking as described in the card terms

benefits.name: Hilton credit
benefits.enrollment_how: Enroll with Amex and register with Hilton for Business.
benefits.qualifying: Eligible purchases made directly at Hilton properties; gift cards are excluded.

benefits.name: Airline incidental credit
benefits.enrollment_how: Select one eligible airline; it can be changed in January.
benefits.qualifying: Eligible incidental fees charged by the selected airline; ordinary airfare does not count.
benefits.note: Whether a charge qualifies depends on how the airline codes the merchant.

benefits.name: CLEAR+ credit
benefits.enrollment_how: Join CLEAR+ and pay with the card.
benefits.qualifying: CLEAR+ membership; the issuer excludes taxes and fees.
benefits.note: Before 2026-07-01 the credit was $209 (older sources also show $189 and $199).

benefits.name: CLEAR+ credit
benefits.enrollment_how: Join CLEAR+ and pay with the card.
benefits.qualifying: CLEAR+ membership; the issuer excludes taxes and fees.
benefits.note: Raised to $219 on 2026-07-01; older $209 figures are superseded.

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck credit
benefits.enrollment_how: No separate Amex activation.
benefits.qualifying: Application fee paid directly through an eligible provider.
benefits.note: Available once every 4 years, for either program: up to $120 for Global Entry or up to $85 for TSA PreCheck. Current issuer terms say 4 years for both; older text gave TSA 4.5 years.

benefits.name: Dell credit
benefits.enrollment_how: Enroll the benefit in the Amex account.
benefits.qualifying: Eligible U.S. purchases made directly with Dell.
benefits.note: Resets January 1.

benefits.name: Dell spend-based credit
benefits.enrollment_how: Enroll the benefit in the Amex account.
benefits.qualifying: Eligible U.S. purchases made directly with Dell, counted cumulatively.
benefits.note: Unlocked by $5,000 of qualifying Dell purchases in the calendar year; resets January 1.

requires.note: $5,000 of qualifying Dell purchases in the calendar year

benefits.name: Adobe credit
benefits.enrollment_how: Enroll the benefit in the Amex account.
benefits.qualifying: Eligible U.S. purchases made directly with Adobe.
benefits.note: Unlocked by $600 of qualifying Adobe purchases in the calendar year.

requires.note: $600 of qualifying Adobe purchases in the calendar year

benefits.name: Indeed credit
benefits.enrollment_how: Enroll the benefit in the Amex account.
benefits.qualifying: Eligible Indeed purchases.

benefits.name: Wireless credit
benefits.enrollment_how: Enroll the benefit in the Amex account.
benefits.qualifying: U.S. wireless telephone service bought directly from a provider.
benefits.note: From 2027-02-17 the credit is limited to select merchants.

benefits.name: ChatGPT Business credit
benefits.enrollment_how: Enroll the benefit in the Amex account.
benefits.qualifying: Eligible U.S. ChatGPT Business subscription purchases.
benefits.note: Amex documented this benefit on 2026-06-05; its first effective date was not found.

benefits.name: ZO membership
benefits.enrollment_how: Activate the ZO membership.
benefits.qualifying: Participating U.S. ZO and Studio locations (reservations where required): 4 guest passes a week and 4 Studio day passes a month.
benefits.note: The exact weekly reset day and rollover rules were not found.

benefits.name: ZO spending credit
benefits.enrollment_how: Activate the ZO membership.
benefits.qualifying: Eligible event-space bookings and/or Dining Club membership; ordinary restaurant dining is not the stated qualifying category.

benefits.name: Amex Travel flight credit
benefits.enrollment_how: Unlocked by spend; no separate enrollment is stated.
benefits.qualifying: Eligible flights booked online through Amex Travel.
benefits.note: Unlocked by $250,000 of qualifying spend in a calendar year and available the next calendar year.

requires.note: $250,000 of qualifying spend in the previous calendar year

benefits.name: One AP credit
benefits.enrollment_how: Enroll in and use One AP; active bank-funded check or ACH payments are required.
benefits.qualifying: One AP monthly platform fees, transaction fees and applicable taxes charged to the card.
benefits.note: Unlocked by $250,000 of qualifying spend and available the next calendar year as an annual pool. Billing in arrears can move usage into another year.

requires.note: $250,000 of qualifying spend in the previous calendar year

benefits.name: Pay with Points airline rebate
benefits.enrollment_how: Select a qualifying airline.
benefits.qualifying: Eligible Amex Travel flights on the selected airline, all eligible cabins.
benefits.note: Returns 35% of points used, up to 1,000,000 points per calendar year, as Membership Rewards points rather than cash. Older descriptions allowing it for premium cabins on any airline are outdated.

benefits.name: Fine Hotels + Resorts benefits
benefits.enrollment_how: Book through Amex Travel.
benefits.qualifying: Participating Fine Hotels + Resorts properties: normally a $100 experience credit, breakfast for two and guaranteed 4 p.m. checkout, plus extras that depend on availability.

benefits.name: The Hotel Collection property credit
benefits.enrollment_how: Book through Amex Travel; minimum two consecutive nights.
benefits.qualifying: Participating properties; property-designated incidentals.

benefits.name: Cruise Privileges
benefits.enrollment_how: Book through Amex Travel.
benefits.qualifying: Participating cruise lines, generally sailings of 5+ nights, up to 3 eligible staterooms: an onboard credit plus an eligible amenity.
benefits.note: The onboard credit ranges from $100 to $300 per qualifying sailing.

benefits.name: Lounge access
benefits.enrollment_how: Enroll in Priority Pass; other networks need an eligible card or ticket.
benefits.qualifying: Global Lounge Collection (Centurion, eligible Delta, Priority Pass and other participating lounges); access and guest rules vary.
benefits.note: Delta Sky Club is normally 10 visits per Delta visit year (Feb. 1 to Jan. 31). Centurion guest access and unlimited Delta Sky Club visits are unlocked by the $75,000 spend threshold.

benefits.name: Hilton Gold status
benefits.enrollment_how: Enroll separately in the Hilton program.
benefits.qualifying: Participating loyalty program benefits.
benefits.note: Ongoing while the card is eligible.

benefits.name: Marriott Gold status
benefits.enrollment_how: Enroll separately in the Marriott program.
benefits.qualifying: Participating loyalty program benefits.
benefits.note: Ongoing while the card is eligible.

benefits.name: Leaders Club Sterling status
benefits.enrollment_how: Enroll separately in the Leaders Club program.
benefits.qualifying: Participating loyalty program benefits.
benefits.note: Ongoing while the card is eligible.

benefits.name: Avis Preferred Plus status
benefits.enrollment_how: Enroll through Amex.
benefits.qualifying: Eligible rentals.
benefits.note: Ongoing while the card is eligible.

benefits.name: Hertz President's Circle status
benefits.enrollment_how: Enroll through Amex.
benefits.qualifying: Eligible rentals.
benefits.note: Ongoing while the card is eligible.

benefits.name: National Executive status
benefits.enrollment_how: Enroll through Amex.
benefits.qualifying: Eligible rentals.
benefits.note: Ongoing while the card is eligible.

benefits.name: Vendor Pay by BILL discount
benefits.enrollment_how: Enroll.
benefits.qualifying: Eligible Vendor Pay Basic plan; other fees may apply.
benefits.note: First user free; second user free for 6 months, then $15 a month. The subscription fee is waived or discounted, not credited.

benefits.name: Airline-fare and dining access
benefits.enrollment_how: Program-specific.
benefits.qualifying: International Airline Program and Platinum airfares, plus eligible dining access.
benefits.note: Value varies and a fixed value was not found. No separate recurring statement credit.

benefits.name: Amex Venue Collection concessions
benefits.enrollment_how: Enroll one eligible Amex card per Card Member.
benefits.qualifying: 10% back on food and drink at participating stadium and arena concessions; tickets, parking and merchandise excluded.
benefits.note: One allowance per Card Member across all enrolled Amex cards.

thresholds.unlocks: Next calendar year's $1,200 Amex Travel flight credit and $2,400 One AP credit.
Complimentary Centurion lounge guest access and unlimited eligible Delta Sky Club visits, each under its own rules. A single universal expiration for both was not found.
Additional $1,000 Dell credit after $5,000 of qualifying Dell purchases.
$250 Adobe credit after $600 of qualifying Adobe purchases.
2x on eligible business categories and on purchases of $5,000 or more, up to this combined amount.

disagreements.topic: Name and scope of the hotel credit

values.value: The main product page still says '$600 Hotel Credit' in places.
Amex Travel terms effective 2026-10-22 describe the broader Lodging Credit, including qualifying Airbnb Luxe.

upcoming_changes.summary: The Fine Hotels + Resorts bookings that count toward the Lodging credit get a two-night minimum; one-night stays stay eligible until then. The Hotel Collection and Airbnb Luxe already need two nights.
The wireless credit becomes limited to select merchants.
